profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Moody's
profile.summary: Staff Software Engineer (Search & Data Platforms) with 7+ years of experience specializing in optimizing search relevance and developing robust data ETL pipelines. Proven expertise in designing, building, and maintaining scalable infrastructures that transform raw data into actionable insights, significantly improving search result accuracy and system efficiency. Passionate about mentoring engineers and introducing them to the sector of search technologies.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led efforts to migrate the Moodys.com Search tech stack from Solr to AWS Opensearch and AWS native technologies
- Brainstormed architecture for a new ETL process using AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, ECS and OpenSearch
- Collaborated with developers, product owners and stakeholders to gather functional and design requirements for the new search experience on Moodys.com
- Implemented hybrid search for Moodys.com’s research assistant artifact search
- Discovered, tested and implemented relevance improvements to Research Assistant’s (RA) hybrid search 
- Safely introduced a 100% increase of entities for RA’s retrieval through RBO, Jaccard and Ranking analysis
- Implemented a round robin algorithm to dynamically build Moodys.com’s search results page thus statistically increasing ERR from .60 to .66, MAP from .56 to .62 and AP from .11 to .14 
- Presented on the SERP Round Robin implementation at the Haystack US 2024 Conference 
- Became a Moody’s Technology Rotation manager and successfully managed three engineers leading to a full time hire on the team 
- Created and facilitate “Relevance Recitation” as a weekly meeting for all team members to analyze search performance and up-skill on relevance engineering techniques

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Trained new rotational software engineers on the Search team, enhancing team efficiency and collaboration
- Provided technical support across environments, ensuring 99.9% uptime for search functionalities
- Migrated the Search stack away from Fusion by assisting in the designing, building and testing of a new custom Search API layer for Moodys.com using Spark, Scala, Java, AWS Lambda, AWS SQS and AWS MSK 
- Analyze, report, and remedy differences between Fusion API and Moody’s Analytics Search API

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed an API using ASP.Net Core and AWS S3 for seamless document sharing between third party vendors
• Built an internal dashboard from scratch with a React JS frontend and ASP.NET MVC and SQL backend. 
• Collaborated with financial engineers from various Structured Finance desks to create and implement necessary views, stored procedures, processes, monitoring jobs and flows in SQL and C#
Created automated installation and startup scripts in bash to update the search stack (Solr, Fusion, Spark, Zookeeper, and Hadoop)
• Curated and presented a talk on self-videos to Executive Stream guests at Moody’s Analytics Summit 2018
• Built automated deployment jobs in Jenkins for search projects 
• Managed Fusion upgrade process from Fusion 3.4 to 4.3 and tackled  data inconsistencies between the differing versions of Fusion
• Completed user stories to enhance and improve the search functionalities on Moodys.com

positions.title: Study Abroad Ambassador - Student Engagement Committee Member
positions.description:
•	Plan, market, and manage events that are geared towards engaging students with the study abroad office
•	Hold office hours to mentor students though their study abroad process
•	Represent the Study Abroad Office during events, presentations, and on-campus

positions.title: Computer Science Undergraduate Department Representative
positions.description:
• Represent the Undergraduate Computer Science majors in Department meetings 
• Evaluate the Computer Science Department twice a semester 
• Plan, market, and produce workshops, events, and panels to supplement the student body’s interests

positions.title: Introduction to Java Mentor
positions.description:
• Facilitate recitations with a small group of Introduction to Java students 
• Provide motivational and educational support to help students achieve new academic heights
• Develop practice problems to test class concepts and hone computational skills

positions.title: Student Support Services Computer Science Peer Tutor
positions.description:
•	Facilitated small group review sessions with students to answer questions and explain computational concepts
•	Provided motivational and educational support to help students achieve new academic heights
•	Developed practice problems in Java to test class concepts and hone computational skills

positions.title: Innovation, Education, and Strategy Intern
positions.description:
•	Conducted research on alumni initiatives for competing organizations 
•	Designed college directory to house GWC collegiate alumni data through the creation of use cases, personas, and interviews
•	Built a prototype directory using SQL, PHP7, JavaScript, HMTL, and CSS
•	Presented and demoed final prototype to GWC national staff and CEO

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
• Gathered functional requirements from Business point of contacts for Qualcomm’s Android Camera Integration team dashboards
• Created UI markups for three dashboards based on specified design and functionality criteria
• Implemented three dashboards in PHP7 that will be utilized as a template for Qualcomm’s own database hub

positions.title: President
positions.description:
• Delegate responsibilities to executive board officers 
• Preside at all membership and executive board meetings
• Recommend and establish goals and objectives for the club with the approval of members

positions.title: Information Technology Intern
positions.description:
• Collaborated with Moody’s IT Product Development team through the functional design phase to receive functional requirements on Moody’s Investor Contact Management Project
• Created and drafted use cases, functional flows, navigational flows, and system overviews that were presented to project approvers three times a week 
• Handled logistical matters and conducted Salesforce walkthroughs to aid in running Joint Application Sessions between users, approvers, and IT 
• Participated in weekly seminars and workshops lead by Moody’s executives

positions.title: Girls Who Code Club Founder & Club Ambassador
positions.description:
• Coordinated with school administrators and Girls Who Code National for club approval
• Recruited 15 high school girls to attend classes in computer science, graphics, and animation 
• Provided classroom support by expanding on material and assisting students with their code
• Acted as a liaison between club teachers, school administration and students

positions.title: Participant
positions.description:
• Completed an eight week course in computer science, web design, robotics, and mobile development
• Participated in daily seminars, workshops, and demos with leaders in the STEM field
• Coded mobile applications, websites, and games on teams and individually
• Created a mobile application, No Bark, as an independent project using jQuery Mobile

positions.title: Participant
positions.description:
• Learned the basics of architecture, construction, and engineering from Swanke Hayden Architect staff
• Assisted with the exterior design of a simulated apartment complex in a team of four
• Presented completed architectural and structural design of project at JP Morgan
